accounting.rationale: J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, PDF 80, printed 66, lines 18-21: four explicit canonical operation references, not a newly owned operation matrix. The actual section title is Intrinsic operations on intrinsic types.

Numeric intrinsic operations on integer, real and complex are specified in 10.1.5.2.1 (PDF 176). Read with 10.1.5.1 operand restrictions and the real/complex integer-exponent exception, this cross-reference neither grants all operand combinations nor creates local arithmetic effects.

Relational operations on numeric and character types are specified in 10.1.5.5 (PDF 180-181). The reference preserves the canonical complex equality-only and character kind premises, and is not permission for numeric/character mixing or logical equality with ==.
Character concatenation is specified in 10.1.5.3 (PDF 178-179), including the same-kind premise. No new local concatenation test or noncharacter invalid twin is attributed to this reference.

Logical intrinsic operations are specified in 10.1.5.4 (PDF 179), with canonical permitted operands, truth tables and evaluation rules. This reference does not turn logical values into integers or own another truth-table program.

review_rationale: Independent source-first review and verified integration corrections: doc/source_audits/batch_009.json. All source items preserve the numeric, relational, concatenation and logical operation references without importing operation semantics or manufacturing a local executable requirement.
